symbols.name: HolidayNotificationSubscription
doc: One row per subscribed user. No row means "never registered" -- distinct from `suppressAfterFirstView` being true with the notification already seen, which means "registered, but currently muted." Deleting this row IS the "complete unsubscribe" -- I deliberately leave no separate "subscribed: false" flag behind, so re-registering later starts fresh rather than silently reactivating old preferences.

members.name: suppressAfterFirstView
doc: Default false, as explicitly instructed: the DEFAULT behaviour is to show the notification at every fresh login. Turning this on is an opt-in "only show me this once" preference, not the default.

members.name: hasSeenFirstNotification
doc: Only meaningful when suppressAfterFirstView is true. It tracks whether the one allowed showing has already happened, so it is not shown again on later logins.
